questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the purpose of “Cost and Resource Optimization”?
options: Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.
Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.

Cost and Resource Optimization is a performance decision, not a rule to apply blindly. Start from a representative query and data distribution, inspect explain() evidence, and compare read improvements with write, memory and storage overhead.
